directions.title: NET-49: THE-REAL-MODEL-KNEE-COLLAPSES-AND-SATURATES — on Qwen2.5-0.5B the lossless attention knee is {16,32,24} at ctx={512,1024,2048}, 24–64x below the toy law d*ctx/32, sub-linear and declining; selection importance inflates an order of magnitude
directions.description:
## NET-49 — limited-memory axis, round 1 (paper 134, /tmp/exp_net49_qwen_topk.py + exp_net49b_sub32.py, /tmp/net49.log + net49b.log)

**Verdict name: THE-REAL-MODEL-KNEE-COLLAPSES-AND-SATURATES.**

### Result
On a REAL PRETRAINED LLM — **Qwen2.5-0.5B** (24 layers, GQA kv=2), wikitext-103 held-out eval, fp32, forward validated EXACTLY against HF eager before any measurement (max|Δlogit| = 0.0000) — the lossless attention knee is:

| ctx | full acc | k\* | toy product d·ctx/32 | ratio |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 512 | 0.4460 | **16** | 384 | **1/24** |
| 1024 | 0.4612 | **32** | 768 | **1/24** |
| 2048 | 0.4787 | **24** | 1536 | **1/64** |

Scaling ×2.0 then **×0.75 — sub-linear and already DECLINING**: P3 confirmed, P1 refuted 16× beyond its floor, P2's linearity half-refuted (its concentration half held: k\* ≤ ctx/8 everywhere). **The DEPTH MULTIPLIER of the toy law collapses from d to ~1 on pretrained weights** — no compounding r(k)^d penalty binds trained attention.

### Key numbers
- Sweeps (retained): 512: 8 0.9617 ✗, **16 0.9834 ✓ (+0.44 SE razor)** … 192 0.9997; 1024: 16 0.9771 ✗ (−0.55 SE), **32 0.9912 ✓** … 384 1.0003; 2048: 4 0.8762 ✗, 8 0.9408 ✗, 16 0.9708 ✗ (−2.5 SE), **24 0.9818 ✓ (+0.5 SE razor, bracket (16, 24])**, 32 0.9867 … 768 0.9997.
- **Selection importance inflates an ORDER OF MAGNITUDE**: random-k gaps **+82.0/+71.8/+81.9/+70.0/+79.9/+68.0 pts** (the toy programme's entire range was +1.7–11.7); local-window gaps +40–55 pts — k=256 local reaches only **0.598 retained at 2048** while oracle top-k is 0.9867 with 8× fewer keys.
- **Depth-resolved concentration map (new measurement class)**: median-layer effective support ≈ 10–12 keys, context-INDEPENDENT across 512→2048 (toy: 46→526); the ONLY diffuse attention lives in **L22/L23** (eff 51→83→128.5 and 33→50→72, sub-linear growth; even L22@2048 is 3.9× less diffuse than the toy MEAN layer); minimum at L16 (2.9 keys).
- **Practical**: oracle working set = 24 of 2048 rows → **85× fewer KV reads / 64× fewer KV bytes per sequence**. Deployable policy needs a cheap selector — the oracle-to-policy gap is named as the next cell, not claimed.

### All 8 barriers
(a) clean — data-free oracle from the model's own scores; horns concerned position/scaling, not existence; (b) confronted — sparse/oracle attention and heavy-hitter eviction exist (H2O/StreamingLLM/SnapKV lineage); NEW content = measured laws: first transfer under this programme's fixed 0.98-retention protocol, the depth-multiplier collapse, the ctx/32-then-decline shape, the 10× selection-gap inflation, the depth map — none in Catalog re-scan or literature; (c) CONFRONTED HEAD-ON — this IS the real-scale cell (pretrained 0.5B, natural web text, 151k vocab); honest limit: ONE model, ONE size; (d) clean — last 10% held out, zero training; (e) SUBSTANCE + limits — deterministic eval (addendum reproduced the baseline EXACTLY, 0.4787/2.6355), binomial SEs 0.17–0.35%, TWO razor-thin knees documented, the 1024 bracket (16, 32] un-pinned at 24 (the decline could be flat ~24), one model one corpus (Gutenberg rate-limited mid-round; wikitext fallback engaged automatically); (f) clean — validation gate passed exactly pre-measurement, fp32 throughout, loss tracks accuracy at every k, NO crash (ALL_DONE_NET49 + ALL_DONE_NET49B); (g) fair — full reference + the SAME 0.98 bar as all 48 prior rounds + random-k AND local-window at matched k, both dominated; (h) DIRECT — the axis's founding question answered with a 64× KV-byte reduction at the knee vs the toy family's best-ever 12.8× attention reading.

### Next
(1) per-layer pruning ablation — is L22's diffusion load-bearing? (2) size transfer — Qwen2.5-1.5B / quantized-offloaded 7B: does ~ctx/32 saturation persist? does the two-layer tail recur? (3) oracle-to-policy gap — online accumulated-score eviction vs this upper bound; (4) corpus robustness; (5) weight-quantization floors on the same harness (limited-memory iteration 2).

Now 49 network experiments. Assessment v49. Paper 134.

directions.title: NET-50: THE-TROPICAL-LIMIT-IS-LOSSY-BUT-THE-RECOVERY-IS-FAST — argmax attention retains only 0.25-0.36 on Qwen2.5-0.5B, k=4 recovers to ~0.9, knees {16,32,24} replicate NET-49 exactly; Maslov-gap map isolates the diffuse tail as the only far-from-tropical region
directions.description:
## NET-50 — limited-memory axis, round 2 (paper 135, /tmp/exp_net50_tropical.py, /tmp/net50.log)

**Verdict name: THE-TROPICAL-LIMIT-IS-LOSSY-BUT-THE-RECOVERY-IS-FAST.**

### Result
Pushing the NET-49 oracle top-k sweep down to the tropical limit on Qwen2.5-0.5B (same gates; forward validated exactly vs HF before measurement):

| k | 512 | 1024 | 2048 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0.3637 | 0.2885 | **0.2503** |
| 2 | 0.7865 | 0.7398 | 0.7002 |
| 4 | 0.9097 | 0.8906 | 0.8762 |
| 8 | 0.9617 | 0.9485 | 0.9408 |
| knee | **16 ✓** | **32 ✓** | **24 ✓** |

- **P1 CONFIRMED**: pure argmax attention is catastrophic everywhere and WORSE at longer context (0.364 → 0.289 → 0.250).
- **P2 CONFIRMED**: k=2 recovers ~0.70–0.79, k=4 ~0.88–0.91 (razor over the 0.90 bar at 512), k=8 ~0.94–0.96.
- **Knee chain {16, 32, 24} replicates NET-49 EXACTLY** — different script, different session: deterministic-eval reproducibility proven.

### The Maslov-gap map (new measurement)
Per-row LSE − max of causal scores, per layer: bulk medians **0.17–1.86 nats** (within log 8 ≈ 2.08) at 512/1024; at 2048 all bulk layers ≤ 1.46. The ONLY far-from-tropical region is the diffuse tail: **L22/L23 medians 2.33/2.16 → 2.55/2.37 → 2.69/2.52 across contexts**, p90 ≈ 3.4. Crystallization loss Σp(1−p): per-layer means **0.34–0.97** — P3's "≤ 0.25" REFUTED honestly. Real attention carries heavy soft mass that is individually tiny but collectively load-bearing: top-k to 24 keys still retains ≥98%.

### Practical reading
The deployable regime is **"tropical core + thin soft correction"**: pointer-style (k≈1–4) caches sit far below the knee, but the measured recovery curve quantifies exactly what each added key buys (k=1→2: +0.34–0.45; k=2→4: +0.12–0.17; k=4→8: +0.05–0.07). This is the deployment-relevant curve for aggressive KV compression on small-VRAM hosts.

### All 8 barriers
(a) clean — cliff/recovery/budget horns pre-stated; (b) clean — argmax-limit sweeps + Maslov/crystallization budget measurements on a pretrained LM not in Catalog or literature as measured laws; (c) confronted — real-scale pretrained model, natural text; honest limit: ONE model; (d) clean — held-out last 10%, data-free selection; (e) SUBSTANCE + limits — cross-session exact replication of {16,32,24} is the strongest reproducibility evidence of the axis; P3's crystallization half honestly refuted; single model/corpus; (f) clean — exact validation gate, fp32 throughout, NO crash (ALL_DONE_NET50); (g) fair — full reference, same 0.98 bar; random-k/local-window controls inherited from NET-49 (not re-run here — noted); (h) DIRECT — sub-k\* recovery curve is what an aggressive KV policy needs.

### Next
Per-layer ablation (prune ONLY L22/L23?); size transfer (1.5B / offloaded 7B); oracle-to-policy eviction gap; corpus robustness; weight quantization vs the 2Lr defect band (NET-52 next).

Now 50 network experiments. Assessment v50. Paper 135.

directions.title: FACT round-37 #5 — DIAL-OVERLAP-LAW: partially overlapping dials are exactly one bit redundant (paper 133)
directions.description:
Round-37 #5 (exp 462, assessment v242). The open cell between paper 91's coprime-synergy (+0.129) and shared-disc-redundancy (−0.99) is CLOSED.

**H1 CONFIRMED — PARTIAL-OVERLAP-LAW**: two genuinely different S3 fields sharing their quadratic subfield are EXACTLY one bit redundant.

Pairs found by scanning 56,410 S3 cubics: d=−7: x³−5x−5 (disc −175=−7·5²) & x³−3x−5 (−567=−7·9²); d=−3: x³−6x−6 (−108) & x³−3 (−243). Measured deficits +0.9998/+0.9998/+1.0000 vs the 1-bit law (deviations ≤ 0.0002).

Derivation committed BEFORE simulation: Gal(L₁L₂/Q) = S₃ ×_{C₂} S₃ (order 18); co-information = H(C) − H(C|X) = 1.5 − 0.5 exactly; all fiber-product correlation beyond the shared sign character confined to the residue-invisible χ_d=+1 fiber. Joint Chebotarev distribution matches order-18 class proportions; off-diagonal mass 34,375 vs predicted 34,307.

Controls clean: coprime synergy reproduced (0.1300 vs lab 0.1290), conjugate pair at full redundancy, which-factor wall NULL on the new joint.

Insights for the programme: (L11) MI signatures CANNOT distinguish partial-overlap from same-field pairs — discriminators are type-agreement (7/9 vs 1.0) and off-diagonal mass; sparse joint moduli distort plug-in MI badly (~±0.5 bits at 2 samples/cell) — joints need ~100 samples/cell or explicit bias modeling; disc-value arguments are not field arguments (index² trap caught live).

The overlap ladder is closed at the pair level: coprime (+synergy) / shared-subfield (exactly −1 bit) / same-field (full redundancy).

directions.title: FACT round-38 #4 — EXTERNAL-HINT-FILTER: one scalar prices everything, the barrier-map triptych completes (paper 138)
directions.description:
Round-38 #4 (exp 468, assessment v247). The third row of the barrier map, derived and machine-verified.

**Master law**: Speedup(H) = 1/(1 − (1−θ)·P_hit) — ALL information acts through the single scalar P_hit. Paper 132's 4/3 cap is exactly the UNINFORMATIVE POINT of this law (H ⊥ p).

- **Symmetry break located**: internal readings die on the fiber-uniformity step; a hint's likelihood lives on the non-c-measurable coordinate and survives it verbatim.
- **Canonical partition law** 8/(7−2α): α=½ reproduces 4/3; α=1 gives only 8/5 < 2 — the WHICH-FACTOR CEILING: external hints capped at 2× per dial; beyond it only via ISOLATION-COST log₂π(√N) oracle queries (net-positive from t=5).
- **Certain-hint ladder** 2^(t−2)/(1−2^(1−t)): two bit-losses identified (parity + which-factor).
- **Trace hints** 2^(t−1)/C_t: GENERIC-RECOVERY's ~5×/bit is a constant divisor, not a rate penalty.
- **Break-even** surface α*(θ,ε); internal filters tolerate ε ≤ 1/6, external up to 3/5.

Verification: m=31/400k dev ≤0.0032 across α; χ(c)-split pointwise exact; exhaustive m=3..8 max dev 0.0089; ladder ratios 0.9986–1.0045; break-even verdicts 20/20.

THE COMPLETED MAP: residues cap 4/3 (theorem) | position 5.19× measured (paper 137) | external linear-in-bits with the 2× per-dial ceiling (theorem here). External info priced linearly — capacity synergy does not transfer to work bits.

directions.title: FACT round-39 #1 — QR-SMOOTHNESS: the QR bite is variance, not mean (paper 139)
directions.description:
Round-39 #1, cron iteration (exp 471, assessment v248). Paper 136's queued follow-up — and a correction of it.

**Ensemble: the QR restriction carries NO penalty.** x²−N smoothness equals UNRESTRICTED-random smoothness at every cell (emp_x2 ≈ emp_rnd within noise; 0.87–0.99 of mean-ρ = paper 130's finite-x factor). Mechanism: (N|p)=+1 primes divide x²−N for TWO residue classes of x mod p — double rate on the halved pool compensates exactly. The pre-stated H1 refuted spectacularly: QR-pool-restricted randoms run 21–56× lower. Paper 136's effective-u story RETIRED.

**Per-N variance is the real mechanism**: corr(per-N smooth rate, #{odd primes ≤100 that are QRs of N}) = 0.50/0.45/0.48/0.40 across cells; decile spread 2.4× at u=2.5 and **9.3×** at u=3.5.

Resolves paper 136's anomaly: its ONE-N-per-scale design sampled this variance (the 0.54–0.76 yield ratios were draw luck, not a systematic deficit). Actionable: per-N relation yield is cheaply predictable a priori from ~20 Euler-criterion tests.
